title: Coordinated capture throttler & replay integrity audit for heterogeneous multi-stream decode
creator: Marco Silva
description:
Background: We've observed intermittent nondeterministic failures during CUDA graph replay when multiple decode streams with heterogeneous sequence/prefill patterns are captured and replayed concurrently. These manifest as rare token corruption, out-of-order KV usage, and occasional graph replay aborts under high concurrency. Root causes appear to be: (1) bursts of capture activity creating partially-initialized graph segments, (2) kernel scheduling races when streams share fused-attention kernels with different occupancy requirements, and (3) replay path assumptions that a capture epoch is globally quiesced.

Goal: Implement a lightweight coordinated capture throttler (sequencer) plus an automated replay integrity audit that reduces nondeterministic replay failures to <0.01% of decode invocations and provides actionable telemetry for future hardening. This ticket covers design, implementation, test harnesses, and a staged rollout with observability hooks.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Introduce a capture sequencer that enforces per-GPU micro-quiesce windows and a global per-cohort token watermark. 2) Replay integrity audit runs in CI and in canary runs and flags mismatches (token-level diff) with an SLO of <0.01% mismatches over 100k replayed decodes. 3) No measurable latency regression (>1%) at p95 for our multi-stream decode benchmark. 4) New telemetry (capture-latency, sequencer-throttle-rate, replay-diff-rate) emitted to console and dashboard. 5) Rollout plan executed with canary, dark run, then 50% traffic, with automatic rollback on >0.05% regression.
technical_notes:
Design summary: - Capture Sequencer: token-watermark-based gating that allows captures to advance only when the cohort watermark moves forward or when a fast-path threshold is reached. Implemented as a per-GPU sequencer object with bounded queue and backpressure signals to request-routing. - Micro-quiesce window: configurable 2-8ms default; tuned by workload. - Kernel affinity hints: sequencer will annotate captures with kernel-affinity metadata so the scheduler can prefer compatible kernels for adjacent segments. - Replay Integrity Audit: deterministic seed + token-level diff harness integrated into unit & integration tests; uses golden outputs for a representative corpus and a sampling mode for production canaries. - Fallback policy: when sequencer is saturated, route new requests to a lower-parallelism decode variant (e.g., single-stream fallback) to preserve correctness.

Implementation plan: 1) Add sequencer proto and API in runtime core. 2) Integrate with capture manager to gate cudaGraph capture start. 3) Emit telemetry via statsd/tracing for console. 4) Build CI fuzz harness and golden-replay tests. 5) Add an in-flight sampling auditor in canary workers that compares replay tokens to baseline and logs diffs to S3 and the replay dashboard.
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for sequencer edge cases: queue wrap, watermark regressions, and fast-path threshold.
- CI regression suite: 100k synthetic replays across mixed sequence lengths and quantization configs; golden output diffing.
- Stress test on preemptible instances and burst traffic patterns to validate fallback.
- Local fuzz harness added to runtime repo for weekly long-running runs.
- Canary run: enable auditor in 2 canary hosts for 48 hours and run sampling at 1% of traffic; verify zero unhandled replay aborts and replay-diff-rate below acceptance threshold.
- Performance gate: compare p50/p95/p99 with current baseline; must be within 1% for p95 and 3% for p99.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (dev): feature branch with sequencer disabled by default; unit tests and CI audit enabled. Phase 2 (canary): enable sequencer and auditor on 2 canary GPUs, sample 1% traffic for 48h, monitor metrics. Phase 3 (dark run): enable sequencer on 20% capacity but do not route customer traffic through it; monitor internal traces and synthetic workloads. Phase 4 (gradual rollout): 10%->25%->50% with 24h observation windows and automatic rollback on replay-diff-rate >0.05% or p95 latency regression >1%. Phase 5: full rollout and merge cleanup.
risks_mitigation: Risks: - Sequencer misconfiguration causing backpressure and increased latency. Mitigation: conservative defaults, realtime telemetry, and automatic fallback to low-parallelism decode. - Kernel-affinity annotations could increase scheduler complexity and cause suboptimal kernel selection. Mitigation: keep affinity hints advisory and add sampling to validate kernel choices. - Golden baselines might miss new model variants. Mitigation: sampling auditor uses model-version tagging and will skip mismatched model versions; run baseline update job when model is intentionally upgraded.
